metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2024 · Young Hearts
metas.description: Elias develops feelings for his new neighbor Alexander. He soon realizes he's falling in love for the first time.

metas.name: ★ 9.0 · 2026 · Baththa
metas.description: In 1986 Madras, a timid eight-year-old boy accidentally locks a feared criminal inside a school restroom. As the man faces hunger and isolation, an unexpected friendship forms between them, transforming both their lives.

metas.description: Amélie, a Belgian child in Japan, explores life with her companion Nishio-san. Her third birthday becomes a turning point, marking the beginning of life-altering events that shape her understanding of the world.
